race.comment: CHAMPAGNE LANE (6) is a genuine danger after storming home up the fence first-up at the Gold Coast. Tackled Listed company before the break and was far from disgraced. Suspect she's got plenty more to offer second-up. DR FARTHING (5) should be hitting his straps now after two solid 1000m efforts to kickoff the prep. Was well-backed last time at Toowoomba but came up just short. Thompson sticking is a big push. DARK ARTS (4) was better than the bare fifth last week after covering ground here and has the track-and-trip win on the board. Drawn to be doing his best work late again. PUFF 'N' HARRY (1) drops back in trip off 59 days in between runs and gets an important 3kg claim. His best is up to this.
